sect1.title: DESCRIPTION
sect1.para: The BundleViewV7 class is a helper class for reading/parsing/validating all blocks within Bundle Protocol Version 7 bundles. The class makes it easy to modify specific blocks and rewrite (rerender) bundles to new memory. Bundles may be rerendered in-place if the bundle is decreasing in size or if there is enough padding available if the bundle is growing in size. The class keeps track of which blocks have been modified (marked dirty) so that CBOR serializaton does not need to be performed on unmodified blocks during a rerender. See TestBundleViewV7.cpp for usage examples.
